Privacy Policy / 隱私權政策

Last updated: 2026-10-31

最後更新：2026-10-31

About this policy

Pro Annotation Ruler is developed by Wen-Hao Chang. This policy covers the current local-first iOS version. Core features do not require an account. Developer-operated cloud sync, advertising, tracking and analytics are not enabled. We do not receive your project or customer records through the app.

關於本政策

Pro Annotation Ruler 由張文豪開發。本政策適用於目前以本機作業為主的 iOS 版本。核心功能不需要帳號，目前未啟用開發者提供的雲端同步、廣告、追蹤或使用分析。我們不會透過 App 接收你的專案或客戶紀錄。

Data used on your device

The app stores the project drawings, measurements, photos, quotations, pricing catalogs, templates, customer names, phone numbers, addresses and company details that you enter or import, to provide editing, search, quotation and export features. Business card text recognition runs on the device. You review and confirm recognized details before saving. If you choose to keep a card image, an encrypted image copy is saved in the app; the original in Photos remains under your control.

裝置上使用的資料

App 儲存你輸入或匯入的專案圖面、尺寸、照片、報價、價目表、模板、客戶姓名、電話、地址與公司資料，用於編輯、搜尋、報價及匯出。名片文字辨識在裝置上執行，辨識結果由你核對確認後儲存。若選擇保留名片照片，App 會儲存加密影像副本；照片圖庫中的原始照片仍由你管理。

Permissions and your choices

Camera access is used for site photos and business card capture; photo access lets you choose existing images. Optional Face ID or device authentication protects access to the app; the operating system handles biometric data, and the app receives only the authentication result. Calendar access lets you create or update linked construction events in a calendar you select. You may decline optional permissions or revoke them in iOS Settings; the related feature will then be unavailable or limited.

權限與選擇

相機權限用於拍攝現場與名片，照片權限用於選取既有影像。可選用 Face ID 或裝置驗證保護 App 存取；生物辨識資料由作業系統處理，App 只接收驗證結果。行事曆權限用於在你選定的行事曆建立或更新關聯施工事件。你可以拒絕選用權限，或在 iOS「設定」撤銷權限，相關功能將無法使用或受到限制。

Sharing, calendars and backups

Data leaves the app when you choose to export, share, save a backup, open a phone or map action, or link a calendar event. The chosen recipient, app, storage provider or calendar account handles that data under its own terms and privacy policy; calendars and device backups may sync according to your system/account settings. Check the destination and included details before proceeding. Encrypted backups can be saved to a location you choose; protect the backup recovery key. Exported documents and project packages may contain personal data and are not all encrypted. We do not operate those external services or automatically send your records to them.

分享、行事曆與備份

當你選擇匯出、分享、儲存備份、使用電話或地圖功能，或關聯行事曆事件時，資料會離開 App。所選接收者、App、儲存服務或行事曆帳號依其條款與隱私政策處理資料；行事曆與裝置備份可能依系統／帳號設定同步。操作前請確認目的地及包含的資料。加密備份可儲存至你選定的位置，請妥善保管備份還原金鑰。匯出的文件與專案封裝可能包含個人資料，且並非全部加密。我們不營運上述外部服務，也不會自動將你的紀錄傳送給它們。

Retention and deletion

Local records remain until you edit or delete them using the app. You can remove a saved card image without removing other customer details. Temporary files may remain after an interrupted operation until cleanup succeeds. Deleting the app removes its local container, but does not remove exported files, recipient copies, original photos, calendar events or system/cloud backups. Manage those copies in their respective apps or services. Keychain items may survive app removal. Export a restorable encrypted backup before uninstalling if you want to keep your work; a PDF is not a complete project backup. We cannot recover or remotely delete records held only on your device.

保存與刪除

本機紀錄會保留至你在 App 中編輯或刪除。你可以移除已儲存的名片影像而保留其他客戶資料。操作中斷後，暫存檔案可能保留至清理成功。刪除 App 會移除其本機容器，但不會刪除匯出檔案、接收者副本、原始照片、行事曆事件或系統／雲端備份；請在各自的 App 或服務管理這些副本。鑰匙圈項目可能在移除 App 後保留。若要保留工作內容，解除安裝前請先匯出可還原的加密備份；PDF 並非完整專案備份。我們無法復原或遠端刪除僅存於你裝置上的紀錄。

Contact and support

For privacy questions or support, contact Wen-Hao Chang at wenhaochang.dev@gmail.com. If you email us, we receive the address and information you choose to send and use them to respond and resolve your request. Avoid sending customer records or backup recovery keys. Support correspondence is kept only as needed to handle the request and applicable obligations; contact us to request deletion of correspondence we hold. Email is handled by the email providers involved.

聯絡與支援

隱私問題或使用支援，請聯絡張文豪：wenhaochang.dev@gmail.com。若你寄信給我們，我們會收到寄件地址與你主動提供的內容，用於回覆及處理請求。請勿寄送客戶紀錄或備份還原金鑰。支援往來僅在處理請求及適用義務所需期間保留；可來信要求刪除我們持有的往來資料。電子郵件由相關郵件服務商處理。

Children

The app is a professional work tool and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. Contact us if a child has sent personal information through support.

兒童

本 App 是專業工作工具，並非針對 13 歲以下兒童。我們不會刻意蒐集兒童個人資料；若兒童透過支援信箱傳送個人資料，請與我們聯絡。

Policy changes

We will update this policy and its revision date when practices change. The policy included in the app remains available offline; the public policy is available at the address below.

政策變更

資料處理方式變更時，我們會更新本政策及修訂日期。App 內附政策可離線閱讀，公開政策網址如下。

wenhaochang.dev@gmail.com
